description:
## [1.71.0](https://github.com/mwbra130/Retro-Bowl-College/compare/v1.70.0...v1.71.0) (2026-11-13)

### ✨ New Features

* add YouTube Music (Wear OS) background playback patch for 9.45.41-WEAR_RELEASE ([1bf64a5](https://github.com/mwbra130/Retro-Bowl-College/commit/1bf64a5e6218d9ff9ef3071e643eef4c9ae1d1f5))

patches.name: Enable Premium
patches.description: Unlocks Premium (the one-time all-features purchase) and every individually sold feature.

patches.name: Disable PairIP protection
patches.description: Lets the patched app run: replaces PairIP's VM startup with harvested vault/handle data, removes the signature check and license dialog, installs the decrypted native libraries and runtime classes, and fixes camera streaming. DroidCam 10.0 only.

patches.name: Unlock Pro
patches.description: Unlocks DroidCam Pro (HD/4K, no watermark, all options): the license verdict is forced to Pro and renews itself at every silent re-check. Requires 'Disable PairIP protection'. DroidCam 10.0 only.

patches.name: Bypass PairIP application checks
patches.description: Required for re-signed builds: PairIP's Application class runs the signature and license checks at startup. This rewrites that one method so it only registers the app context and never calls either check, instead of relying on the checks themselves being stubbed.

patches.name: Bypass PairIP license check
patches.description: Required for re-signed builds: PairIP asks Google Play to license the app at startup and sends non-Play installs to a Play Store block page. Disables that check, its verdict handler, both block-page launchers, the delayed shutdown, and the block activity itself so the patched app can open.

patches.name: Change installer source
patches.description: Spoofs the installer source so the app appears to be installed from Google Play everywhere it is read. Pre-selected companion for the DiskWala patch set — keep it on.

patches.name: Disable PairIP license activity
patches.description: Required for re-signed builds: removes PairIP's LicenseActivity from the manifest entirely, so the Play Store block page and license error dialog can never be shown, whatever tries to open them.

patches.name: Disable ads
patches.description: Stubs AppLovin, AdMob, InMobi and other ad SDKs at the bytecode level to prevent ads from loading without breaking the app.

patches.name: Disable forced update
patches.description: Bypasses PairIP license check ('Download from Play Store'), Play Integrity, and signature verification to allow modified and sideloaded app usage.

patches.name: Enable Premium
patches.description: Turns on Premium (no ads, real file names, HD downloads, faster streaming) as if subscribed. Keep the pre-selected PairIP bypass patches on — a re-signed build cannot pass PairIP's startup license check without them.

patches.name: Patch native libraries
patches.description: Neutralizes PairIP traps in native .so libraries and patches Hermes bundle. Also applies the standalone-install manifest fixes (real Application class, original component factory, native library extraction) and removes the stock baseline profiles.

patches.name: Unlock premium
patches.description: Makes RevenueCat entitlements appear active so ads-free and premium features are unlocked.

patches.name: OLED black mode
patches.description: Turns the dark theme true black (#000000) for OLED screens: backgrounds and surfaces go pure black, raised containers (cards, bubbles, sheets) become near-black steps so they stay visible. Dark theme only — light mode is untouched. Needs the stock APK of the target version (messages.android_20261020_00_RC01.phone_dynamic, the universal APK — not a BUNDLE — from APKMirror: https://www.apkmirror.com/apk/google-inc/messenger-google-inc/); Morphe Manager also suggests that exact version when you don't have the file. A few settings screens on Android 12+ take surfaces from the system palette and stay dark grey.

patches.name: Remove background playback restrictions
patches.description: Removes restrictions on background playback in the Wear OS app. Experimental: fingerprint verified against 9.45.41-WEAR_RELEASE, not yet tested on a watch.

patches.name: Change installer source
patches.description: Spoofs the installer source so the app appears to be installed from an app store. Required for Enable Pro to take effect — keep it on.

patches.name: Enable Pro
patches.description: Unlocks Echo Pro (the lifetime tier: Auto EQ, limiter, compressor and all other Pro features). Use with Change installer source.

patches.name: Remove ads
patches.description: Stops interstitial ad breaks and native ads in the notes list from loading (Google Mobile Ads). Rewarded ads that unlock features when watched are left working. Does not unlock premium.

patches.description: Required for re-signed builds: PairIP checks the APK signature at startup and crashes the app on launch when it is not the developer's. Disables that one check so the patched app can start.

patches.description: Unlocks Web Video Caster Premium (ad removal, ad block, bookmarks, queue and the other premium features). No real purchase is made.

patches.description: Required for re-signed builds: PairIP asks Google Play to license the app at startup and sends unlicensed installs to a Play Store block page. Disables that check, its verdict handler and both block-page launchers so the patched app can open.

patches.name: Enable Pro
patches.description: Turns on the app's Pro state (no promo ads, premium light effects, custom app and contact colors, every setting) with the permanence of the one-time purchase.

patches.name: Enable Premium
patches.description: Grants Premium, whose only features over Basic are no ads and VIP support: removes all banner and interstitial ads (the player, playlists and equalizer are already free).

patches.name: Unlimited coins and keys
patches.description: Coins and keys always report 2,147,483,647, so every purchase is affordable. Ported from legendsciber's Currency Hack and re-anchored for 3.71.0.

patches.name: Bypass PairIP signature check
patches.description: Required for re-signed builds: PairIP verifies the app's signing certificate at startup and kills the app if it isn't the Play signature. This disables that one check so the patched app can open.

patches.name: Enable Premium
patches.description: Unlocks all premium features and removes ads by enabling the app's top donation tier state (the Dinner tier) — no purchase is made.

patches.name: Change installer source
patches.description: Spoofs the installer source so the app appears to be installed from Google Play. Required for Video Cutter: its PairIP local installer check is live, so a re-signed build fails the license check without it — keep it on.

patches.name: Remove ads
patches.description: Removes all ads, as if the Remove Ads purchase were bought. Also enable the Change installer source patch (pre-selected).

patches.name: Bypass integrity check
patches.description: Stops the Play Integrity (Raindrop) verdict from blocking the app. If the app already shows App Blocked, reinstall it fresh after patching.

patches.name: Change installer source
patches.description: Spoofs the installer source so the app appears to be installed from an app store.

patches.name: Enable Premium
patches.description: Unlocks RainViewer Pro. Use with Change installer source.

patches.name: Unlock Premium
patches.description: Unlocks Poweramp's full version state and Feature Package #1.

patches.name: Unlock premium
patches.description: Unlocks all games (VIP). The store sees the one-time VIP purchase as owned — no real purchase is made.

patches.name: Unlock premium
patches.description: Unlocks the full version. No real purchase is made.

apps.app_name: ISS Live Now: Live Earth View

patches.name: Enable Premium
patches.description: Turns on the app's Pro state (no ads, Pro features) as if the Pro version were purchased.

patches.name: Remove ads
patches.description: Stops banner and interstitial ads from loading (Google Mobile Ads).

patches.name: Bypass PairIP license check
patches.description: Required for re-signed builds: PairIP asks Google Play to license the app at startup and sends unlicensed installs to a Play Store block page. Disables that check, its verdict handler and both block-page launchers so the patched app can open.

patches.name: Enable Lifetime VIP
patches.description: Turns on the lifetime Life Member (SVIP) state: no ads and every animated theme applies for free, with no expiry — the VIP screen reads Level: SVIP and Status: life member. Needs the stock Pika! Spot 1.4.5 XAPK.

patches.name: Spoof app signature
patches.description: Fixes the 'Can not connect to server' stop at 30% on launch: the app's first server login carries a token derived from the APK signing certificate, and a re-signed build computes it from the wrong certificate, so the server rejects the login. Recomputes the token with the stock signing certificate. Needs the stock Pika! Spot 1.4.5 XAPK.

patches.name: Remove ads
patches.description: Stops banner, interstitial and app-open ads from loading (AppLovin MAX). Rewarded ads for hints are left working.

patches.name: Enable Full
patches.description: Unlocks Unified Remote Full for free, as if the one-time Full purchase were bought: 70+ remotes, no ads, screen mirroring, floating remotes, extended keyboard, widgets and quick actions, voice commands, custom remotes, IR and NFC actions.

patches.name: Unlimited coins & unlocks
patches.description: Sets cash to 9,999,999, every upgrade card to 10,000, unlocks ALL vehicles and characters (no spinning needed), unlocks the Pro Pass, slot/lottery machines, completes all main + side missions, and maxes vehicle durability. Backs up your save before touching it. To revert: place an empty file named SR2_RESTORE.txt in Android/data/com.rkgames.basisgame/files/ and open the game.

patches.name: Unlock All Slot Machines
patches.description: Unlocks all slot machines (1/2/3) without Google Play purchase. Patches the native ownership checks to always grant the machines.

patches.name: Change installer source
patches.description: Spoofs the installer source so the app appears to be installed from Google Play. Required for BusinessX: its PairIP local installer check is live, so a re-signed build fails the license check without it — keep it on.

patches.name: Enable Premium
patches.description: Grants Premium's on-device features: inventory & sales export (PDF/Excel/CSV), full sales history and trends, shop sharing, no ads, and Google Drive backup. BusinessX Cloud backup/sync are authorized on the developer's server and may still require a real subscription.

patches.name: Add settings
patches.description: Long-press the Home tab in Strava's bottom bar to open 'Morphe patch settings'. Lets you toggle feed cleanup, route trim, bottom bar tabs and the launcher name/icon at runtime, without re-patching.

patches.name: Custom app name and icon
patches.description: Changes the app's displayed name and launcher icon. The icon choices are Strava's own built-in alternate icons, plus an accent-colored one. Name and icon can later be switched at runtime from the patch settings screen.

options.description: The custom name the launcher can show. The original name stays available in the patch settings screen.
The launcher icon. Uses Strava's own built-in alternate icons, plus an accent-colored one.

patches.name: Custom theme colors
patches.description: Replaces Strava's brand orange (#FC5200) accent color in the app's native screens with a color of your choice.

options.description: The accent color that replaces Strava orange.

patches.name: Enable password login
patches.description: Shows the email and password login option instead of forcing the one-time email code flow. Your password is still checked by Strava's servers exactly as in the official app.

patches.name: Hide feed elements
patches.description: Hides who-to-follow suggestions, suggested challenges and other clutter cards from the activity feed. Requires the 'Hide subscription promotions' patch, which provides the shared feed filtering.

options.description: Popular athletes, followers, people near you etc.
Random challenges Strava wants you to join.
Your activity from X years ago
The 'See what events are happening' local events carousel.

patches.name: Hide subscription promotions
patches.description: Hides subscription upsell modules and promotional cards from the feed and other modular screens. UI cleanup only: does not unlock any paid features.

options.description: Elements that promote features, challenges, clubs, etc.

patches.name: Local route privacy trim
patches.description: Trims extra route distance from both ends of the activity map on this device only, on top of Strava's own privacy filtering. Display-only: recorded and uploaded data are unchanged, and other people still see the activity exactly as your Strava privacy settings dictate.

options.description: Extra meters of route hidden from each end of the activity map on this device.

patches.name: Enable Premium
patches.description: Unlocks Patrocine (Cifra Club Pro) and removes ads: registered users get no interstitials and banner hosts treat them as registered.

patches.name: Change installer source

patches.name: Enable Pro

patches.description: Spoofs the installer source so the app appears to be installed from Google Play. Required for Yin Yang Launcher: its PairIP local installer check is live, so a re-signed build fails the license check without it — keep it on.

patches.name: Enable Premium
patches.description: Unlocks Yin Yang Pro for free, as if the Lifetime purchase were bought: all clocks, fonts, live wallpapers and icons. Also enable the Change installer source patch (pre-selected) — it is required for the patched app to pass the license check.

patches.name: Free store
patches.description: The in-game store is free. Just tap "Buy" and the item is yours — no payment needed. For an ad-free game, just buy the ad-block item from the store.

patches.name: Unlimited gold
patches.description: Your coin balance always shows 65,535 and spending coins always works without deducting any — pull the prize machine and buy coin characters as much as you want.

patches.name: Unlock all characters
patches.description: Every character is unlocked and playable — paid, coin, prize machine, progress and secret characters included. Your real collection progress is not changed; characters are unlocked while the patch is applied.

patches.name: Enable Premium
patches.description: Turns on the app's premium state (premium features, no ads) as if a lifetime premium were active.

patches.name: Remove ads
patches.description: Removes ads (Appodeal mediation and the direct Amazon ads path), hides the app's own rotating promo bars (the bottom house-promo bar and the downloads-screen VPN/Telegram offer strip) and the green "Upgrade to 1DM+" bar in the settings drawer. Does NOT unlock 1DM+ features — 1DM+ is a separate paid app and its features are not in this app.

patches.name: Change installer source
patches.description: Spoofs the installer source so the app appears to be installed from Google Play. Required for Smart MP3 Tagger: its PairIP local installer check is live, so a re-signed build fails the license check without it — keep it on.

patches.name: Enable Lifetime Pro
patches.description: Turns on the app's Pro state (no ads, unlimited functions) as if the one-time "Super Pro Forever" purchase were owned — the lifetime state, with nothing to expire.
